watches.name: HERITAGE CHRONOGRAPH
watches.description: HERITAGE CHRONOGRAPH — Sales limited to 99 watches per color Inspired by chronographs of the 1930s and 1940s, HERITAGE CHRONOGRAPH combines a snail tachymeter-inspired dial, pulsometer-inspired details, a stepped bezel and a VK64 meca-quartz movement. Choose Salmon Grey, Black Grey or Brown Olive. A maximum of 99 watches will be sold in each color. Specifications Movement: VK64 meca-quartz, with instant-reset chronograph operation Case: 316L stainless steel Dimensions: 40mm diameter, 47mm lug-to-lug Crystal: Double-domed sapphire with anti-reflective coating Water resistance: 10 ATM Caseback: Stainless steel with logo engraving Crown: 7mm diameter Strap: Genuine leather, 20mm at the lugs tapering to 18mm at the buckle Colors and straps Salmon Grey — beige strap Black Grey — black strap Brown Olive — dark brown strap Delivery, warranty and returns Free tracked shipping within Japan and to eligible international destinations. Orders normally dispatch within 2–3 business days. Import duties and local taxes may apply. One-year warranty for eligible movement manufacturing defects confirmed by inspection. Normal battery depletion and battery replacement are excluded. Cancellations are free within 48 hours of purchase; a 10% fee applies afterward. Returns are subject to the published store policy and applicable statutory rights.

watches.name: TYPE ART-DECO
watches.description: Art Deco geometry in a distinctive 38mm automatic watch. TYPE ART-DECO draws on the forms of 1930s Art Deco, combining unusual U-shaped lugs with two different dial designs. ADA-01 features an asymmetrical tricolor mirror dial; ADR-01 features a salmon matte dial with Roman numerals. Case: 38mm, 316L stainless steel Thickness: 10.7mm Lug-to-lug: 45mm Movement: MIYOTA Cal. 90S5 automatic Crystal: Box-shaped sapphire with AR coating Water resistance: 5 ATM Design and final inspection: Japan Assembly and origin: China Delivery: Free tracked shipping within Japan and to eligible international destinations. Import duties and local taxes may apply to international orders. Warranty: One year of coverage for eligible movement manufacturing defects confirmed by inspection. watches.name: WORLD TIME
watches.description: A vintage-inspired automatic watch with an engraved rotating city bezel. WORLD TIME takes its design cues from classic travel watches. A manually rotating bezel engraved with city names frames a dial featuring Roman numerals, applied markers and dauphine hands. The city bezel is a design feature; it does not automatically display the time in multiple cities. Choose WTB-01 Black or WTS-01 Silver. Both feature a 38mm stainless-steel case, MIYOTA Cal. 9039 automatic movement, domed sapphire crystal and 10 ATM water resistance. Delivery: Free tracked shipping within Japan and to eligible international destinations. Import duties and local taxes may apply to international orders. Warranty: One year of coverage for eligible movement manufacturing defects confirmed by inspection. See our store policies for full terms.
